lines.en: label cafe10:
scene cafe_day
I make my way into the cafe a bit more tired than usual because, for some reason, the world decided to spite me by disallowing me to sleep for more than an hour at a time last night.
lines.zh: 我踏进咖啡馆，比平时更累一点，因为不知为什么，这世界昨晚决定跟我作对，让我一次睡不了一个小时以上。

lines.en: But apart from how hard it is to be me and how cruel the world can be at times, I am now prepared to see my favorite barista and consume whatever strange concoction she cooks up for me today.
lines.zh: 不过，抛开「做我有多难」以及这世界有时有多残酷不谈，我现在已经准备好见我最喜欢的咖啡师，喝下她今天给我调出来的任何奇怪玩意儿。

lines.en: scene cafeten1
Or not.
lines.zh: 或者见不到。

lines.en: : Good morning! How's your day going so far?
lines.zh: : 早上好！今天过得怎么样？

lines.en: : It's...fine. And yours?
lines.zh: : 还……行。你呢？

lines.en: : Living the dream.
lines.zh: : 活在梦里。

lines.en: : That bad, huh?
lines.zh: : 那么糟啊？

lines.en: : Thank you for being the first person to ever understand how canned and robotic that response is.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，你是第一个听出这句话有多像罐头话、多像机器人的人。

lines.en: : I take it you've worked in customer service before?
lines.zh: : 我猜你以前做过客服？

lines.en: : No, I've just gotten very good at bantering with baristas lately.
lines.zh: : 没有，我只是最近跟咖啡师斗嘴斗得特别熟练。

lines.en: scene cafeten2
: Oh. So this isn't your first time here?
lines.zh: : 哦。那你不是第一次来这儿？

lines.en: : Nope. I guess you could say I've become a bit of a regular.
lines.zh: : 不是。你也可以说，我已经算是个常客了。

lines.en: : A bit of a-
lines.zh: : 算是个——

lines.en: scene cafeten3
: Wait, you wouldn't happen to be Rin's teacher, would you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你该不会就是 Rin 的老师吧？

lines.en: : I would. I'm a little surprised to have you guess that based on...literally no information apart from being a new regular, though.
lines.zh: : 正是。不过你能凭……除了「新常客」之外毫无信息就猜出来，我有点意外。

lines.en: scene cafeten4
: Well, it's not like we've had many customers that fit your description lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，最近来这儿的客人里符合你描述的本来也没几个。

lines.en: : That description being?
lines.zh: : 什么描述？

lines.en: : The owner of a penis.
lines.zh: : 拥有阴茎的人。

lines.en: : Well, that's a fun new way to say {i}man.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可是个说「{i}男人{/i}」的有趣新方式。

lines.en: scene cafeten5
: Thanks for always stopping by, though. I think you'll be happy to know that I let Rin add her mystery beverage to the menu after reading your comment card.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你经常光顾。你大概会很高兴地知道，看了你的意见卡之后，我让 Rin 把她的神秘饮料加进菜单了。

lines.en: : I don't really think the part about her being the best barista ever was necessary, though. Especially since I'm the proud owner of that title.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得「史上最棒咖啡师」那部分其实没必要。尤其这个头衔的骄傲拥有者是我。

lines.en: : Well, as the proud owner of a penis, I would like to congratulate you for being the actual best barista and will offer Rin my condolences the next time I see her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，作为一根阴茎的骄傲拥有者，我要恭喜你才是真正最棒的咖啡师，下次见到 Rin 我会向她表示哀悼。

lines.en: : Sensei! Don't give in that easily! You know in your heart of hearts that it is I, Rin Rokuhara, who is the true champion of (copyrighted frozen beverages)!
lines.zh: : Sensei！别这么轻易就倒戈啊！你心里最清楚，真正的（受版权保护的冷冻饮品）冠军是我，Rin Rokuhara！

lines.en: Rin calls out from behind me and I begin to question how I walked in without noticing her.
lines.zh: Rin 从我身后喊了起来，我开始怀疑自己是怎么走进来却没注意到她的。

lines.en: : So, what would you like? I don't want to keep you from talking to your regular barista for too long.
lines.zh: : 那么，您想要点什么？我可不想占用你跟你的专属咖啡师聊天太久。

lines.en: : Just a black coffee is fine.
lines.zh: : 一杯黑咖啡就行。

lines.en: : Oh, and your name.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有你的名字。

lines.en: scene cafeten6
: Haruka.
lines.zh: : Haruka。

lines.en: : And yours?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : You can just call me Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你叫我 Sensei 就行。

lines.en: scene cafeten7
: Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Yup. And I'll just take a black coffee, please.
lines.zh: : 对。那我就要一杯黑咖啡，谢谢。

lines.en: : But...your name-
lines.zh: : 可是……你的名字——

lines.en: scene black
: You can just write {i}Sensei{/i} on the cup. It's fine.
lines.zh: : 你在杯子上写{i}Sensei{/i}就行。没关系的。

lines.en: : But...but...
lines.zh: : 可是……可是……

lines.en: Haruka stands there for a moment as if she's waiting for the punchline to a joke.
lines.zh: Haruka 站在那儿愣了一会儿，像是在等一句笑话的笑点。

lines.en: Unfortunately, that punchline never comes and she is forced to awkwardly pour me a drink without ever learning my true identity.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，那个笑点始终没有出现，她只好尴尬地给我倒了杯饮料，却始终没能问出我的真实身份。

lines.en: She finishes and hands it to me across the counter, eyes unblinking and focusing on mine.
lines.zh: 她调好之后隔着柜台递给我，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着我的眼睛。

lines.en: I stare back, nod, then walk away.
lines.zh: 我也回视着她，点了点头，然后走开了。

lines.en: scene cafeten8
: What the Hell was that? You trying to look cool in front of my boss or something?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么情况？你在我老板面前耍帅还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Did it work?
lines.zh: : 奏效了吗？

lines.en: : She's still staring at you, so...I think so?
lines.zh: : 她还在盯着你看，所以……我想是奏效了吧？

lines.en: Excellent.
lines.zh: 很好。

lines.en: : Also, aren't you here a little later than normal today? You actually caught me on my real break for once.
lines.zh: : 另外，你今天来得比平时晚一点吧？你居然难得撞上我真正的休息时间。

lines.en: : Yeah...I couldn't really get any sleep last night, so I wound up not getting out of bed until a little while later.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我昨晚没怎么睡着，所以拖了一会儿才起床。

lines.en: : How come? Nightmares or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？做噩梦什么的？

lines.en: : Nothing like that. Just one of those nights, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不是那回事。大概就是那种夜晚吧。

lines.en: scene cafeten9
: Guess I can feel that. I've had my share of sleepless nights, but I'm typically a pretty heavy sleeper when my brain isn't exploding.
lines.zh: : 我能体会。我也熬过不少不眠之夜，但只要脑子没炸开，我一般睡得挺死的。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Oh yeah. You could probably beat me with a pillow or something and I'd stay asleep.
lines.zh: : 哦，真的。你大概拿枕头打我什么的，我都不会醒。

lines.en: : That’s kind of worrying in the event of some type of emergency.
lines.zh: : 万一出什么紧急情况，这还挺让人担心的。

lines.en: scene cafeten10
: Nah, I'm sure Futaba would rescue me if something like that ever happened.
lines.zh: : 没事啦，真出那种事的话，Futaba 肯定会来救我的。

lines.en: : Unless she's just been pretending to like me all these years and is secretly waiting for me to die.
lines.zh: : 除非她这些年一直都在装作喜欢我，暗地里等着我死。

lines.en: : That doesn't sound like Futaba.
lines.zh: : 这不像 Futaba。

lines.en: : I don't think so either. But I guess you never truly know someone until they have to save your life due to unforeseen circumstances.
lines.zh: : 我也不这么觉得。不过我想，大概只有在对方因为意外情况救了你一命之后，你才算真正认识一个人。

lines.en: : That's...yeah, okay.
lines.zh: : 这……是啊，好吧。

lines.en: scene cafeten11
: So, you finally got to meet my boss.
lines.zh: : 那么，你终于见到我老板了。

lines.en: : Yeah. And she even got me exactly what I asked for. I didn’t realize this place could do that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且她还真给了我要的东西。我都不知道这地方还能这么点单。

lines.en: : Thoughts? She your type?
lines.zh: : 感想如何？是你的菜吗？

lines.en: : That depends. Is this a trick question?
lines.zh: : 那要看情况。这是陷阱题吗？

lines.en: scene cafeten12
: No way! You can tell me. We're pals, right?
lines.zh: : 才不是！你可以告诉我的。我们是哥们儿，对吧？

lines.en: : Plus, we have today off, so it's kind of like you're not even my teacher.
lines.zh: : 再说我们今天都休息，所以差不多就当你不是我老师了。

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t think the time of day really determines my relationship with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得几点钟并不能真的决定我和你的关系。

lines.en: : Hot or not, Sensei? Hot or not?
lines.zh: : 辣不辣，Sensei？辣不辣？

lines.en: : She's attractive, yeah.
lines.zh: : 她很有魅力，是的。

lines.en: : And...{i}very{/i} well endowed.
lines.zh: : 而且……{i}非常{/i}有料。

lines.en: scene cafeten13
: You've got that right. Those things could feed a village of starving children for like a decade.
lines.zh: : 你说得太对了。那玩意儿够喂饱一村子的饥童十年。

lines.en: : I...don't think starving children would need to breastfeed for ten whole years...but I...guess I wouldn't blame them for wanting to?
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得饥饿的儿童需要喝上十年母乳……不过我……大概也不会怪他们想喝？

lines.en: scene cafeten14
: Well, sorry to break your heart, but she’s married.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉要让你心碎了，不过她已经结婚了。

lines.en: : Then why did you make it sound like you were trying to hook me up?
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛说得好像想撮合我们似的？

lines.en: : Cause I figured that would be the easiest way to get you to tell the truth.
lines.zh: : 因为我猜那是让你说实话最简单的办法。

lines.en: : Is her husband still around with the whole space war thing going on?
lines.zh: : 她丈夫还活着吗，毕竟还有太空战争那档子事？

lines.en: scene cafeten10
: Nope. He got drafted a few years ago and she hasn’t seen him since.
lines.zh: : 不在。他几年前被征召了，从那以后她就没再见过他。

lines.en: : She's actually really torn up about it underneath the buxom, bubbly exterior, though.
lines.zh: : 其实在那丰满又元气的外表底下，她为这事伤心得不行。

lines.en: scene cafeten15
: I {i}may{/i} know someone else who’s into you, though. And it may or may not be a girl you know pretty well.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}大概{/i}还认识另一个对你有意思的人。而那个人可能是、也可能不是你挺熟的一个女孩。

lines.en: : But you’ve gotta promise not to tell her I told you.
lines.zh: : 但你得保证不告诉她是我说的。

lines.en: : I'm guessing it's one of the students, then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜是学生之一了？

lines.en: scene cafeten16
: Woah! How did you know?
lines.zh: : 哇！你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Well if it’s not Haruka, it kind of has to be. I don't really know anyone else.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果不是 Haruka，那就只能是了。我别的人也不认识。

lines.en: : Oh, true. Good point.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。有道理。

lines.en: : But yeah, it's a student. And she may or may not be my roommate.
lines.zh: : 不过是的，是个学生。而且她可能是、也可能不是我的室友。

lines.en: : Ahh, so it's Futaba you're talking about.
lines.zh: : 啊，所以你说的是 Futaba。

lines.en: scene cafeten15
: Bingo!
lines.zh: : 答对了！

lines.en: : Yeah, I kind of figured. She tends to trip over her words whenever she talks to me, so...kind of a dead giveaway.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我大概猜到了。她跟我说话的时候总是舌头打结，所以……挺明显的。

lines.en: if futabadorm15 == True:
She has also had my penis in her hand, but I don't think that's a detail I should really divulge right now.
lines.zh: 她也把我的阴茎握在过手里，不过我觉得这个细节现在还是别说出来比较好。

lines.en: scene cafeten17
: Yeah...I guess she's never been good at hiding her feelings.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我想她从来都不太会隐藏自己的感情。

lines.en: : Not that she's ever really had any romantic ones but, like...yeah. Just speaking her mind has always been kinda tough for her.
lines.zh: : 她也没真的经历过什么恋爱感情，不过……对。把自己的想法说出口，对她来说一直都挺难的。

lines.en: : Truth be told, she’s been head over heels for you since the first day of school.
lines.zh: : 说实话，从开学第一天起，她就为你神魂颠倒了。

lines.en: : Is it really okay for you to be telling me this?
lines.zh: : 你把这些告诉我，真的没关系吗？

lines.en: : As long as you don’t tell her I told you, I don't think there's a problem with it.
lines.zh: : 只要你不告诉她是我说的，我觉得没什么问题。

lines.en: : If anything, I see it as kind of a favor. Who knows when she'd tell you on her own?
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我觉得这算是在帮你们。谁知道她自己什么时候才会告诉你？

lines.en: : How is revealing a friend's secret a favor, exactly?
lines.zh: : 泄露朋友的秘密怎么就成了帮忙了？

lines.en: : Because now that you know someone as cute and cuddly as Futaba is attracted to you, aren't you tempted to take things a little further?
lines.zh: : 因为既然你现在知道像 Futaba 这么可爱、这么好抱的人对你有意思，你就没点想再进一步吗？

lines.en: : Is that...actually something you're okay with?
lines.zh: : 这个……你真的能接受？

lines.en: scene cafeten8
: Hm? Why wouldn’t it be? If it makes the two of you happy, I’m all for it.
lines.zh: : 嗯？为什么不能？只要你们两个开心，我举双手赞成。

lines.en: : That’s...a little unexpected.
lines.zh: : 这……有点出乎意料。

lines.en: : You do realize how much older I am than you, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我比你们大多少岁吧？

lines.en: scene cafeten9
: Mm...That kind of stuff doesn't really matter to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那种事我其实不在乎。

lines.en: : I'm sure it wouldn't really fly in school, but it's not my business to tell you where you can and can't stick your wiener.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定在学校里这肯定行不通，不过你爱把香肠往哪儿塞，轮不到我来管。

lines.en: : I know if {i}I{/i} had a wiener, {i}I'd{/i} want to stick it in Futaba. She smells nice and her skin is really soft.
lines.zh: : 我知道，要是{i}我{/i}有香肠，{i}我{/i}也想塞进 Futaba 里面。她闻起来很香，皮肤也很软。

lines.en: : This is a side of you I did not expect to come out today.
lines.zh: : 你这一面我可没料到今天会冒出来。

lines.en: : I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不后悔。

lines.en: : Rin, are you almost done over there? Your break ended five minutes ago.
lines.zh: : Rin，你那边快好了吗？你的休息五分钟前就结束了。

lines.en: scene cafeten18
: Ahh...shoot. I didn't realize what time it was. I've gotta get back to work.
lines.zh: : 啊……靠。我都不知道几点了。我得回去干活了。

lines.en: scene cafeten14
: Try and get some sleep tonight. Okay, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 今晚尽量睡一会儿。好吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : And remember to not tell Futaba what I told you or I will sell your organs for discounted rates on the black market.
lines.zh: : 还有，别忘了别把我说的话告诉 Futaba，不然我就把你的器官打折卖到黑市上。

lines.en: : You really scare me sometimes, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真把我吓到，Rin。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: scene black
I follow Rin back to the counter to dispose of my remaining coffee and watch her disappear into the kitchen.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Rin 回到柜台，处理掉剩下的咖啡，看着她消失在厨房里。

lines.en: Haruka, still in an apparent state of shock after giving me her name only to be robbed of mine, stares blankly at me as I nod to her once more and make my way out of the cafe...
lines.zh: Haruka 显然还处在「报上了自己的名字、却被抢走了我的名字」的震惊中，呆呆地盯着我；我再次朝她点了点头，走出了咖啡馆……

lines.en: $ cafe10 = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
